why: Figure B is figure A turned upside down (rotated 180 degrees). So D must be figure C rotated 180 degrees: the white leaf goes on top and the black leaf comes to the bottom, pointing down-left. That is option 3. Option 2 also has white on top, but its black leaf points down-right, so it is a mirror image, not a rotation.
trick: To check a 180 degree turn, every part must go to the opposite side: top to bottom AND left to right.
